result.title: Don't Just Impute, Detect: Task-Aware Diffusion Pipelines for Edge Anomaly Detection
result.comment: 11 pages, 6 figures. Accepted at the 33rd IEEE International Conference on High Performance Computing, Data, and Analytics (HiPC 2026)
result.summary: Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) edge pipelines routinely lose contiguous blocks of multi-sensor data to network dropouts and hardware faults. The standard remedy is a disjointed "impute-then-detect" pipeline whose imputer is trained only for Mean Squared Error (MSE). Such an imputer fills a missing block with the most probable normal pattern: a partially observed anomaly is smoothed back toward normality, and boundary artifacts on normal data raise false alarms. We call this imputation bias and propose the Task-Aware Diffusion Refiner (TADR), a conditional diffusion refiner trained against the loss landscape of a frozen downstream detector. Because back-propagating through the sampling trajectory is intractable, the task-aware terms act on the one-step clean-window estimate that the noise prediction already yields, so training costs no more than plain diffusion training. Under strict Point-to-Point evaluation over five seeds with paired significance tests, TADR raises F1 by $0.338$ over the unrefined detector on SMD ($p = 0.0015$), and the anomaly enhancement objective alone contributes $0.463$ in ablation. We also characterise when the method helps: the gain tracks the continuous, mutually redundant channels available and the anomaly evidence the outage removes, and it is absent on telemetry datasets dominated by one-hot command channels and on PSM. At ten sampling steps TADR runs in $41.4$ ms per window on a single CPU core, sustaining about $24$ concurrent 1 Hz streams from a $4.03$ MB model. Code and per-seed results are available at https://github.com/int-park422/TADR.

AI.brief_summary: 针对 IIoT 多传感器缺失块导致「先插补再检测」流程中的插补偏差，提出 TADR：以冻结下游检测器的损失景观训练条件扩散精修器，并用噪声预测的一步干净窗口估计承载任务感知项，避免对采样轨迹反传。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「插补偏差」——按 MSE 插补会把部分观测的异常平滑回常态——与 LVR 中任务必要细节在内部状态里被坍缩的问题同构；而用下游任务损失塑造扩散状态、又绕开采样轨迹反传的做法，可供核查作为 latent 状态训练监督与贡献分配的借鉴线索。
